items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: one of the first arrangers to use me in that capacity... was Les Baxter

ctx.x: Tell us about studio work for film.

Well I had no plans of becoming a studio player it just kind of happened. The blues part of my playing got me on a lot of record dates, and my playing wasn’t all blues, you know I could play a pretty good ballad and follow changes and stuff like that and had a pretty good sound and I think one of the first arrangers to use me in that capacity, you know other than the blues stuff, was Les Baxter and maybe Van Alexander, Billy May, Nelson Riddle. I was being discovered by arrangers who used me in a solo capacity.…
